test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If a craftsman were to sell a table at Rs. 1,300, he would lose 35%. To gain 30%, he would sell it for :
solution: Given, Selling price of an article = 1300 and makes a loss = 35% Calculation Selling price of an article = 1300, loss = 35% Loss = (cost price - 1300)/cost price × 100
